purpose: Qualify purpose-bound beneficiary name/account verification outcomes and exact payer intent before payment initiation.

source_register.title: Payments Ecosystem Modernisation Position Paper
supports: SARB proposes Verification of Payee / proxy-resolution capability as part of future national payments modernisation
The proposal connects payee confirmation with safer payment initiation and financial identity
does_not_support: A currently operational scheme-wide South African PayShap VoP service
A participant-specific API, coverage or response SLA

source_register.title: QR+ Standard 1.2
supports: QR+ standardises payment-initiation data exchange across QR codes, barcodes and digital links
QR+ includes a PayShap payload
does_not_support: A universal bank account/name verification service
Proof of account ownership, payment authority or settlement

source_register.title: Verification of Payee Scheme Rulebook v1.1
supports: VOP Rulebook v1.1 effective 20 September 2026
Scheme defines response outcomes including match, close match, no match and verification not possible
does_not_support: South African PayShap rule or coverage
Legal identity or ownership proof beyond the scheme's scoped matching response

source_register.title: Verification of Payee Inter-PSP API Specifications v1.1.1
supports: VOP API v1.1.1 effective 20 September 2026
Specification clarifies empty fields, character sets, timestamps, headers and content types
This is an inter-PSP request/response specification

source_register.title: Verification of Payee API Security Framework v2.1
supports: Framework v2.1 establishes security requirements for participant VOP APIs
Security profile is separate from the semantic matching outcome
does_not_support: That a valid API signature proves the account name matches
South African law or local coverage

source_register.title: Recommendations for VOP Matching Processes v2.0
supports: Recommendations v2.0 cover natural/legal person matching, spelling, transpositions, initials, phonetic variations, trading names and abbreviations
Responding PSP remains responsible for its matching outcome and may apply its own criteria
Unicode/character-set handling requires an explicit profile
does_not_support: A match as proof of legal identity, account ownership or payment authority

source_register.title: Instant Payments Regulation and Verification of Payee
supports: EU IPR requires VOP for standard and instant euro credit transfers
The payer is offered VOP free and receives a response before payment authorisation
Outcome distinctions include match, close match, no match and other/verification-not-possible outcomes
does_not_support: A claim that all VoP services worldwide are free

source_register.title: Specific Direction 17: Confirmation of Payee (PS26/2)
supports: UK PSR removed the expiry date from Specific Direction 17 in October 2026
Direction retains Confirmation of Payee obligations for most PSPs
PSR reports scale exceeding 320 organisations and more than two million checks per day
does_not_support: South African provider coverage or obligations
Evidence that check volume equals fraud reduction or match accuracy

profiles.admission: no South-African scheme-wide coverage claim; qualify exact participant before use

profiles.service_scope: verification before standard or instant euro credit transfer
